requirements.evidence: 3-cell linear organizer with compartment bins: bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments for small notions), bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments for tools like scissors/measures), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full (open bin for fabric/ larger items). Joint-bolted and capped.

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell sewing tidy: divided bins provide separate compartments for bobbins, needles, buttons, thread spools, scissors and tape measure; staged with representative small props (tweezers, tapes, screw heaps as notions).

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
